planCriteria.criterion: Given a user views the product catalogue, they can see photos of the ceramic products.
Given a user views a mug, they can see three distinct colour options.
Given a user selects a specific mug colour, the system displays the unique SKU, price, and stock level for that variant.
Given a user selects items, they can add them to a shopping cart.
Given a user enters a valid discount code before the expiry date, the total price is reduced accordingly.
Given a user enters an expired discount code, the system rejects the code and applies no discount.

planCriteria.criterion: Given a user completes a purchase via Stripe Checkout, the payment is processed successfully.

tests: tests/e2e/shop.spec.ts › a shopper pays with Stripe Checkout at server-computed amounts; the signed webhook marks the order paid, decrements each product's stock and logs the confirmation email
planCriteria.criterion: Given a successful payment, the system sends an order confirmation email to the user.
Given a successful sale, the stock level for the purchased SKU is automatically decremented.
Given an admin user logs into the admin panel, they can create, update, or delete products.
Given an admin user logs into the admin panel, they can view a list of all completed orders.
